home.welcome1: Did you know that about 10,000 thoughts come to mind every day?
home.welcome10: Human bones are 4 times stronger than diamonds!
home.welcome12: Did you know bananas are technically berries?
home.welcome13: Gold is edible! Gold leaf is an approved food additive.
home.welcome14: Footprints from Earth are still on the Moon.
home.welcome15: Elephants are the only mammals that can't jump!
home.welcome16: Honey never spoils, even after thousands of years.
home.welcome17: Your stomach creates a new lining every two weeks!
home.welcome18: Polar bear fur is actually transparent, and their skin is black!
home.welcome19: A single laugh releases endorphins in your brain.
home.welcome2: The human brain can perform 1016 calculations per second!
home.welcome20: It takes about 8 minutes for light to travel from the Sun to Earth.
home.welcome21: A chameleon's tongue is twice the length of its body!
home.welcome22: The Eiffel Tower grows 15cm taller in summer due to heat.
home.welcome23: Humans breathe about 20,000 times a day.
home.welcome24: Jellyfish have no brain but can respond to light!
home.welcome25: 70% of Earth is water, but only 1% is drinkable.
home.welcome26: Cats can see in light 6 times dimmer than humans can!
home.welcome27: Saturn is less dense than water — it could float in a bathtub!
home.welcome28: A duck's quack does echo, despite the popular myth!
home.welcome29: Babies have 300 bones, but adults only have 206.
home.welcome3: The deepest ocean on Earth is the Mariana Trench at 11km deep!
home.welcome30: Chocolate was originally made as a drink!
home.welcome31: Sloths only go to the bathroom once a week.
home.welcome32: Most atoms in your body were made inside stars!
home.welcome33: Penguins gift pebbles to their partners — like a proposal!
home.welcome34: Lightning is 5 times hotter than the surface of the Sun!
home.welcome35: Dolphins sleep with one eye open.
home.welcome36: The smallest country in the world is Vatican City!
home.welcome37: A giraffe's tongue is about 50cm long and purple!
home.welcome38: If you fold paper 42 times, it could reach the Moon!
home.welcome39: In space, tears don't fall — they just float around!
home.welcome4: The shortest war in history lasted only 38 minutes!
home.welcome40: Strawberries are the only fruit with seeds on the outside.
home.welcome41: Ants can carry 50 times their own body weight!
home.welcome42: Earth receives about 100 tons of space dust every day.
home.welcome43: Babies have about 90 more bones than adults!
home.welcome44: The smell of rain is called 'petrichor'.
home.welcome45: Every snowflake has a hexagonal structure!
home.welcome46: Koala fingerprints are almost identical to human ones!
home.welcome47: Lightning striking milk could theoretically make yogurt!
home.welcome48: The longest river in the world is the Amazon, not the Nile!
home.welcome49: The human nose can detect about 1 trillion different scents!
home.welcome5: Bees circulate blood using their brain, not their heart!
home.welcome6: Whales sleep with only half their brain while the other half stays awake!
home.welcome7: The longest living animal on Earth is a shark over 400 years old!
home.welcome8: The human eye can distinguish about 10 million different colors.
home.welcome9: Hummingbirds are the only birds that can fly backwards!
